card.name: Unit word after a slash or per
card.fires_on: The denominator unit in a rate or ratio, such as foot, kg, mL or lb, right after a slash or the word per. It also fires on the split-off b of lb.

modes.label: Dose rate denominators
modes.description: The unit after a slash in dosing rates such as mg/kg or mL/kg.

modes.label: After the word per
modes.description: A unit right after per or Per, in costs, doses or concentrations.
modes.example: Starting Daily Dosage Per<< Kg>> Body Weight* 0 to 3

modes.label: Pounds written as lb
modes.description: The last letter of lb after a slash in weight-based doses.

card.plain: It lights up on the unit that closes a ratio, like the kg in mg/kg or the mL in units per mL.
